_about: Extra info per Gemini model for the app, read at startup from GitHub (update without a new release). Today's prices come live from LiteLLM's price list; 'prices' here only matter for scheduled changes (an entry applies up to and including its 'until' date) and as a fallback. 'tested' comes from tools/eval_extraction.py; 'tokens_per_invoice' = measured [input, output incl. thinking]. 'hide' removes models that are listed by Google but don't work here.

gemini-3.8-flash.label: Gemini 3.8 Flash
gemini-3.8-flash.note: Thinking limited to 'low' (measured on real scanned receipts).

gemini-3.5-flash-lite.label: Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite
gemini-3.5-flash-lite.note: Got a refund amount wrong in testing.

gemini-4-argon.label: Gemini 4 Argon
gemini-4-argon.note: Most capable, but the most expensive.

gemini-2.5-pro.note: Deprecated; Google routes it to 3.8 Flash from 2026-12-01.

gemini-2.5-flash-lite.note: Listed, but returns 'not available' when used.

gemini-omni-flash-preview.note: Only works with Google's Interactions API.
